title: 八里污水處理廠~Bali Sewage Treatment Plant
focus: 跨市初級處理與長期設備管理~Intermunicipal primary treatment and long-term asset management
summary: 八里課程聚焦集水、初沉、污泥消化及放流介面，並把跨市流量與設備維護紀錄納入交接；不假設初沉已去除所有溶解污染。~Bali focuses on collection, primary settling, digestion and discharge, including intermunicipal flow and asset records; primary settling is not assumed to remove every dissolved pollutant.

units.title: 跨市集污邊界：污染負荷與採樣邊界~Intermunicipal collection boundary: Pollutant load and sampling boundary
units.mechanism: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「跨市集污邊界」觀察此因果關係。~Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at intermunicipal collection boundary.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
units.verify: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「跨市集污邊界」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for intermunicipal collection boundary; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 濃度較低就表示污染質量一定較少。~Lower concentration necessarily means less pollutant mass.
units.practice: 先點選「跨市集污邊界」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the intermunicipal collection boundary measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 尖峰流量配置：尖峰流量與可用能力~Peak-flow allocation: Peak flow and available capacity
units.mechanism: 平均流量用於年收支，尖峰流量決定瞬時水力負荷；泵站、攔污與沉澱單元可能有不同瓶頸。本單元在「尖峰流量配置」觀察此因果關係。~Mean flow supports annual balances, whereas peak flow governs instantaneous hydraulics; pumps, screens and clarifiers may have different bottlenecks. Examine this relationship at peak-flow allocation.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：平均 Q=0.8 m³/s、假設尖峰係數 f=2.5。公式 Qp=fQ；代入 0.8*2.5 = 2 m³/s。適用邊界：係數為假設，不能代替地方降雨與下水道時序分析。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: mean Q=0.8 m³/s and assumed peak factor f=2.5. Formula Qp=fQ; substitution 0.8*2.5 = 2 m³/s. Boundary: The assumed factor does not replace local rainfall and sewer time-series analysis.
units.verify: 把尖峰歷線疊在各單元可用能力上，找出最早溢流點。在離線場景為「尖峰流量配置」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Overlay the peak hydrograph on available capacity for each unit and identify the first overflow point. Build an offline evidence table for peak-flow allocation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把設計總能力當成檢修時可用能力，會漏算停機風險。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Using installed capacity during maintenance overlooks unavailable equipment. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 平均流量通過即可證明暴雨時不溢流。~Passing mean flow proves that storm overflows cannot occur.
units.practice: 先點選「尖峰流量配置」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把尖峰係數改成3，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2.4 m³/s。與基準 2 m³/s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the peak-flow allocation measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only the peak factor to3 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2.4 m³/s. Compare with baseline 2 m³/s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 進水提升設備：提升水頭與電力~Influent lift equipment: Lift head and electrical power
units.mechanism: 泵的輸入功率須供應流量的位能增加及損失；效率下降會使同一輸送服務耗電增加。本單元在「進水提升設備」觀察此因果關係。~Pump input must provide the hydraulic energy increase and losses; lower efficiency increases electricity for the same conveyance service. Examine this relationship at influent lift equipment.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=0.10 m³/s、H=12 m、總效率η=0.72、ρ=1000 kg/m³。公式 P=ρgQH/(1000η)；代入 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW。適用邊界：穩態不可壓縮流，H含管損；不涵蓋起動、水錘與汽蝕。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=0.10 m³/s, H=12 m, total efficiencyη=0.72 and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Formula P=ρgQH/(1000η); substitution 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW. Boundary: Steady incompressible flow with friction included in H; starting, surge and cavitation are excluded.
units.verify: 同步量測流量、進出口壓差與真實功率，勿把視在功率當耗電。在離線場景為「進水提升設備」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Synchronize flow, pressure difference and real-power measurements; do not confuse apparent and real power. Build an offline evidence table for influent lift equipment; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 葉輪磨損或閥門節流會改變工作點，須查泵曲線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Impeller wear or throttling changes the operating point; inspect the pump curve. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 相同流量下所有泵的耗電都相同。~All pumps consume the same power at equal flow.
units.practice: 先點選「進水提升設備」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把效率降成0.60，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 19.62 kW。與基準 16.35 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the influent lift equipment measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only efficiency to0.60 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 19.62 kW. Compare with baseline 16.35 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 初級沉澱池：表面溢流率與沉降分離~Primary clarifier: Surface loading and settling separation
units.mechanism: 理想沉澱中顆粒沉速相對於表面溢流率決定是否捕集；增加深度主要改變停留與污泥儲存，不能取代表面積。本單元在「初級沉澱池」觀察此因果關係。~In ideal settling, particle settling speed relative to surface overflow rate governs capture; greater depth changes retention and sludge storage but cannot replace surface area. Examine this relationship at primary clarifier.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=6000 m³/d、表面積 A=300 m²。公式 v0=Q/A；代入 6000/300 = 20 m/d。適用邊界：理想離散顆粒近似；絮凝、污泥濃縮、風與短流另行檢核。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=6000 m³/d and surface area A=300 m². Formula v0=Q/A; substitution 6000/300 = 20 m/d. Boundary: Ideal discrete-particle approximation; flocculation, thickening, wind and short-circuiting need separate checks.
units.verify: 用沉降柱與進出水SS比對捕集，不把水清澈當溶解物已去除。在離線場景為「初級沉澱池」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare a settling-column test and inlet/outlet SS; clear water does not prove dissolved contaminants were removed. Build an offline evidence table for primary clarifier; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 排泥不良會讓泥層抬升，造成出水固體增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Poor sludge withdrawal raises the sludge blanket and increases effluent solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 只要把池挖深就能任意增加沉澱流量。~Making a tank deeper permits unlimited settling flow.
units.practice: 先點選「初級沉澱池」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把面積加至400 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15 m/d。與基準 20 m/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the primary clarifier measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only area to400 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15 m/d. Compare with baseline 20 m/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 溶解與顆粒污染區分：去除效率與質量去向~Dissolved/particulate distinction: Removal efficiency and mass destination
units.mechanism: 去除是污染物由水相移到污泥或被轉化；以相同流量比較濃度可估效率，但不能省略副產物流。本單元在「溶解與顆粒污染區分」觀察此因果關係。~Removal moves pollutants from water to solids or transforms them; concentration comparison estimates efficiency at equal flows but does not eliminate residual streams. Examine this relationship at dissolved/particulate distinction.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Cin=200 mg/L、Cout=40 mg/L且進出水量相同。公式 η=100(Cin-Cout)/Cin；代入 100*(200-40)/200 = 80 %。適用邊界：只適用同一物種、同時窗且等流量；不能代替總污染收支。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Cin=200 mg/L and Cout=40 mg/L at equal inlet and outlet flows. Formula η=100(Cin-Cout)/Cin; substitution 100*(200-40)/200 = 80 %. Boundary: Same species, time window and flow only; not a replacement for a complete pollutant balance.
units.verify: 同時量測污泥固體量與水相濃度，對照移除質量。在離線場景為「溶解與顆粒污染區分」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure sludge solids and water concentrations together to reconcile removed mass. Build an offline evidence table for dissolved/particulate distinction; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 以清水稀釋取代處理會讓濃度變低但不一定減少排放質量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Dilution can lower concentration without lowering discharge mass. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 看不到的污染物代表已完全被破壞。~An invisible pollutant has been completely destroyed.
units.practice: 先點選「溶解與顆粒污染區分」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把出水改成60 mg/L，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 70 %。與基準 80 %比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the dissolved/particulate distinction measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only effluent to60 mg/L with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 70 %. Compare with baseline 80 % and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 污泥濃縮輸送：乾固體與含水率~Sludge thickening/transfer: Dry solids and moisture
units.mechanism: 含水污泥總質量由乾固體庫存與固體分率決定；脫水主要移除水而非消滅固體。本單元在「污泥濃縮輸送」觀察此因果關係。~Wet sludge mass follows dry-solids inventory and solids fraction; dewatering removes water rather than destroying solids. Examine this relationship at sludge thickening/transfer.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：乾固體2000 kg/d、固體質量分率0.04。公式 Mwet=MDS/fDS；代入 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d。適用邊界：濃度採質量分率；若體積濃度須先確認密度。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: dry solids2000 kg/d and solids mass fraction0.04. Formula Mwet=MDS/fDS; substitution 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d. Boundary: Concentration is a mass fraction; volumetric concentration requires density.
units.verify: 秤重並烘乾配對樣品，分開報告乾量與濕量。在離線場景為「污泥濃縮輸送」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Weigh and dry paired samples, reporting wet and dry mass separately. Build an offline evidence table for sludge thickening/transfer; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把4%寫成4會造成100倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Using4 rather than0.04 produces a hundredfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 脫水後濕泥減少的質量全都是污染物被破壞。~All wet-mass reduction during dewatering is destroyed pollution.
units.practice: 先點選「污泥濃縮輸送」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把固體分率提高到0.20，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 10000 kg/d。與基準 50000 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the sludge thickening/transfer measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only solids fraction to0.20 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 10000 kg/d. Compare with baseline 50000 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 蛋型消化槽模型：揮發性固體消化~Egg-shaped digester model: Volatile-solids digestion
units.mechanism: 厭氧消化將一部分可降解有機固體轉為氣體；惰性固體保留在消化污泥內。本單元在「蛋型消化槽模型」觀察此因果關係。~Anaerobic digestion converts part of degradable volatile solids to gas; inert solids remain in digestate. Examine this relationship at egg-shaped digester model.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：進料乾固體3000 kg/d、VS分率0.70、VS破壞率0.50。公式 VSdestroyed=MDS fVS η；代入 3000*0.70*0.50 = 1050 kg VS/d。適用邊界：假想穩態質量帳，實際破壞率須以進出料完整固體收支估算。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: feed dry solids3000 kg/d, VS fraction0.70 and VS destruction0.50. Formula VSdestroyed=MDS fVS η; substitution 3000*0.70*0.50 = 1050 kg VS/d. Boundary: Hypothetical steady balance; actual destruction needs complete input/output solids accounting.
units.verify: 測進出料TS與VS並檢查貯槽累積，避免以濃度差代替質量差。在離線場景為「蛋型消化槽模型」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure feed/digestate TS and VS and inspect storage accumulation; concentration difference is not mass difference. Build an offline evidence table for egg-shaped digester model; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 進料量忽高忽低會讓單日去除率誤導。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Variable feeding makes a single-day destruction estimate misleading. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 灰分也能在厭氧消化中全部變成甲烷。~All ash can turn into methane during anaerobic digestion.
units.practice: 先點選「蛋型消化槽模型」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把VS破壞率改成0.60，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 1260 kg VS/d。與基準 1050 kg VS/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the egg-shaped digester model measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only VS destruction to0.60 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 1260 kg VS/d. Compare with baseline 1050 kg VS/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 消化氣計量：COD與甲烷理論潛力~Digester-gas metering: COD and theoretical methane potential
units.mechanism: 電子當量可把被轉化COD連結到甲烷的理論體積；細胞合成、溶解甲烷與洩漏使實收量較低。本單元在「消化氣計量」觀察此因果關係。~Electron equivalence links converted COD to theoretical methane volume; growth, dissolved methane and leaks reduce collected gas. Examine this relationship at digester-gas metering.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：已轉化COD=1000 kg/d、理論上限0.35 Nm³ CH₄/kg COD。公式 VCH4=0.35 CODconverted；代入 0.35*1000 = 350 Nm³ CH₄/d。適用邊界：Nm³採0°C、1atm基準；上限計量而非廠商產氣保證。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: converted COD=1000 kg/d and theoretical upper factor0.35 Nm³ CH₄/kg COD. Formula VCH4=0.35 CODconverted; substitution 0.35*1000 = 350 Nm³ CH₄/d. Boundary: Nm³ uses0°C and1atm; stoichiometric upper bound, not a supplier guarantee.
units.verify: 將氣量修正到同一溫壓，量測甲烷分率與溶解排出。在離線場景為「消化氣計量」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Normalize gas volume to the same temperature/pressure and measure methane fraction and dissolved losses. Build an offline evidence table for digester-gas metering; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把總沼氣量當純甲烷量會高估可用熱值。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Treating total biogas as pure methane overestimates energy. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 所有COD移除都會轉為可收集甲烷。~Every unit of removed COD becomes collected methane.
units.practice: 先點選「消化氣計量」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把已轉化COD改成800 kg/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 280 Nm³ CH₄/d。與基準 350 Nm³ CH₄/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the digester-gas metering measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only converted COD to800 kg/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 280 Nm³ CH₄/d. Compare with baseline 350 Nm³ CH₄/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 移交儀表校驗：感測器偏移校正~Handoff instrument checks: Sensor offset calibration
units.mechanism: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「移交儀表校驗」觀察此因果關係。~A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at handoff instrument checks.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.
units.verify: 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「移交儀表校驗」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for handoff instrument checks; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 單點校正可以證明整個量程都沒有誤差。~One-point calibration proves the entire range is error-free.
units.practice: 先點選「移交儀表校驗」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the handoff instrument checks measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 設備更新期間服務：備援與共同失效~Service during equipment renewal: Redundancy and common failures
units.mechanism: 平行備援可降低獨立停機造成的服務中斷，但共同電源、進水或控制器會破壞獨立假設。本單元在「設備更新期間服務」觀察此因果關係。~Parallel redundancy reduces outages from independent failures, but common power, feed or controllers invalidate independence. Examine this relationship at service during equipment renewal.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：兩列各自可用率A=0.95且任一列足以供應示範負載。公式 Asys=1-(1-A)^2；代入 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction。適用邊界：僅兩列獨立且容量足夠；不含共同失效或修復時間分布。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: two trains each have availabilityA=0.95 and either meets the hypothetical load. Formula Asys=1-(1-A)^2; substitution 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction. Boundary: Two independent adequate-capacity trains only; common failures and repair-time distributions are excluded.
units.verify: 畫故障樹並標出共享設備，測試單列退出時的完整流程。在離線場景為「設備更新期間服務」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Draw a fault tree marking shared assets and replay the process with one train unavailable. Build an offline evidence table for service during equipment renewal; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 兩列共用一個關鍵閥門，該閥失效仍會同時停產。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A shared critical valve can stop both trains together. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 設備數量加倍就能消除所有停機。~Doubling equipment eliminates every outage.
units.practice: 先點選「設備更新期間服務」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把各列A改成0.90，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.99 fraction。與基準 0.9975 fraction比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the service during equipment renewal measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only each train availability to0.90 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.99 fraction. Compare with baseline 0.9975 fraction and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

history: 新北市官方資料記錄八里初沉與蛋型消化設施，並於2026年3月公布跨市管理移交；課程以此討論持續運轉的交接證據。~New Taipei records primary settling and egg-shaped digestion facilities and announced the intermunicipal management transfer in March2026; the course uses this to discuss continuity evidence.
